basis.by: Inland Revenue (Te Tari Taake), New Zealand
basis.label: Sewerage pumps
basis.note: Printed page 51. Pumping sets category. Printed DV 20%, SL 13.5%. Tax depreciation lives set by the Commissioner of Inland Revenue for New Zealand income tax, not engineering or asset-management lives; they are banded and often short (e.g. reticulation piping 25 years). The July 2021 edition was the newest PDF reachable; the online Depreciation Rate Finder may hold later determinations.

open_questions: HUD's 50 years for sewage ejectors may describe the basin and piping rather than the pump. Pump lives need a second source.
Every source here is a published planning, design or accounting life. None is observed replacement data.
Some maintenance intervals come from TM 5-692-1, an Army manual for mission-critical (C4ISR) facilities; they may be tighter than typical commercial practice.
